why: The standard test board (issue #1009) is what `createArenaWorld` builds, and the suites on it -- the pacifist suite's mine bound most of all, since brown lays no mines -- rely on its mixed roster. The roster is pinned in arena-validation.test.ts by value, apart from arenas.json, so re-authoring campaign level 1 (#1010) cannot move it. This entry is that pin's real failing mutation: the fixture's own teal glyph becomes floor, which is the edit #1010 makes to arena-01, applied to the wrong board. The board still validates, so only the roster pin sees it.
killedBy: the standard test board (issue #1009) holds exactly one brown, one grey, one teal and one player -- pinned apart from arenas.json
